description: This file defines a C# class PromiseForwardGrain implementing an Orleans grain with methods for setting and getting two integer arguments, and interacting with a simple grain interface. It also includes a serializable state class SimpleGrainState.

classes.name: SimpleGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a grain with two integer properties.

classes.name: PromiseForwardGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that provides methods to set, get, and perform operations on two integer arguments, and interacts with an ISimpleGrain instance.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the product of two arguments from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the product of two provided arguments from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: SetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the value of 'A' in the associated simple grain.

methods.name: SetB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the value of 'B' in the associated simple grain.

methods.name: IncrementA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously increments the value of 'A' in the associated simple grain.

methods.name: GetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the value of 'A' from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of 'A' in the associated simple grain asynchronously.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of 'B' in the associated simple grain asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Retrieves the product of two arguments from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Retrieves the product of two provided arguments from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of 'A' in the associated simple grain asynchronously.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Retrieves the value of 'A' from the associated simple grain.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrain
methods.description: Private helper method to obtain the ISimpleGrain instance, creating it if necessary.
